market.question: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (LOW) $95 in May?

assessment.reasoning: Interpreted as Polymarket convention: WTI dips to $95 or below in May. Currently $101.94 with ceasefire optimism dragging prices down ~3% on May 1. Needs ~-6.8% from current; reasonable given continued Iran de-escalation and demand concerns. Not asymmetric either way given two-sided risk.
assessment.key_uncertainty: How fast the geopolitical premium continues to unwind vs new escalations.
